title: Local model for common complexes
statement: For schemes Z,Y [def-pc-scheme], a closed immersion i:Z -> Y [def-weil-closed-immersion], and an additive tensor pullback i* [def-pc-module-pullback], let P,J be cochain complexes on Y,Z respectively [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Assume a:P -> (i_*O_Z)[0] is a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex], every term of P is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], b:O_Z[0] -> J is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], and J is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Define T as the actual termwise tensor pullback i*P, not an arbitrary complex on Z. For every open V of Z and affine open U of Y whose immersion ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is generated by a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], put W=V intersect i^(-1)(U), viewed as an open in V. Restriction Fc to V followed by its over site over W [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] makes Fc(J) K-injective and Fc(T) admit a quasi-isomorphism roof to a bounded finite-free zero-differential complex in the sense of [lem-sc-homology-evaluation-formal-complex].

source.place: duality.tex, lemma-regular-ideal-ext (0BQY), quotient Koszul computation; affine resolution sheafification (068C); cohomology.tex, lemma-restrict-K-injective (08BS), restriction via exact extension by zero.

proof.text: For W=V intersect i^(-1)(U), restrict the explicitly K-injective J along V.ι using openImmersion_restriction_derived_properties, then to the over site W using isKInjective_restrict_localized. The zero-morphism preservation parameter is proved sectionwise by extensionality and rfl. This gives the first conjunct, without any new hole.

Apply local_tensor_has_finite_free_zero_model to i,P,a,hP,hflat,V,U,hU for the second conjunct and pair the two assertions. The tensor-only component contains neither J nor b nor any K-injectivity assertion.

theorem selfExt_tor_resolution_local
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (J : CochainComplex Z.Modules ℤ)
    (a : P ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single Y.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)))
    (b : (HomologicalComplex.single Z.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ J)
    (_hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := Y.sheaf) a)
    (_hflat : ∀ k : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (P.X k))
    (_hb : QuasiIso b) (_hJ : J.IsKInjective) :
    let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    ∀ (V : Z.Opens) (U : Y.affineOpens)
      (_hU : ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f),
      let W := V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      let Fc := moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor Z V W
      CochainComplex.IsKInjective (Fc.obj J) ∧
        HasFiniteFreeZeroModel (V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over W) (Fc.obj T)
